profile.headline: Software Engineer at Everyday Electric (formerly Renew Home)
profile.summary:
1. Three years golang development experience
2. Nineteen years Java development experience
3. Linux application development experience in python
4. Cloud-based microservices development on AWS (and some on GCP)
5. Experience implementing and operating customer facing microservices cloud stack 
6. Extensive customer-facing experience consulting and teaching (pre- and post-sales)
7. Technical writing and course development experience

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Developed tariff data ingestion and interpretation logic for utility bill insights in MCP tools.  
• Designed backend integration for customer support, achieving a 95.5% CSAT score through authenticated API endpoints.  
• Implemented eligibility API with JWKS-based authentication for Embedded Enrollment MVP for OEM partners

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Worked on the 4-person implementation team that built Redpanda Serverless, transitioning a go prototype into a robust production product supporting hundreds of users. Redpanda Serverless is architected as multiple proxies running atop Redpanda Cloud, sharing state via a topic-based write ahead log (WAL). 
- Implemented low-code friendly REST API for Redpanda Serverless.
- Implemented GRPC Dataplane API for Redpanda Serverless.
- Implemented Serverless snapshot to s3 for fast, reliable state restoration on restart. 

- Contributed to the architecture and implementation team that built Redpanda Cloud from the first line of golang code into a production product for customers. Focused on control plane features including entity model, data layer, GRPC APIs, and workflow/event coordination.
- Implemented Postgres Change Data Capture (to event queue) module in go, serving as the communication link between the control plane and data plane of Redpanda Cloud.
positions.insights: Skills: Go (Programming Language) · Linux · Google Cloud Platform (GCP) · Terraform · Amazon Web Services (AWS)

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Developed cloud platform analytics in an AWS microservices environment including EC2, SQS, Kinesis, DynamoDB, and S3, while employing Terraform for infrastructure management. 
- Led projects focused on data center platform security, implementing key management, encryption and authorization mechanisms.
- Implemented Hardware Security Module (HSM) support to serve customers with strict compliance requirements.
- Promoted to Staff and Senior Software Engineer.
positions.insights: Skills: Linux · Core Java · Amazon Web Services (AWS)

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Developed an opaque object storage system primarily focused on key management in python. 
- Designed and developed web administration UI in Java.

Gazzang acquired by Cloudera, June 2014.
positions.insights: Skills: Linux · Python (Programming Language) · Encryption · Key Management

positions.title: Product Developer
positions.description:
- Developed and maintained Java client application to snapshot, restore and distribute Enterprise Java application server configurations.
- Developed and maintained web application to manage application release workflows based on DevOps methodologies.

positions.title: Customer Care Manager
positions.description:
- Provided technical support to both customers and sales staff using Phurnace Deliver for configuration management and application deployment.
- Conducted on-site training of new customers and occasional post-sales consulting.
